_readme: 英雄特征卡：只描述「她是什么」，不描述原图的构图/姿势/镜头。文生图按这里造新画面，因此每张可以有自己的舞台与镜头。palette 由 scripts/aso/hero_features.py 从立绘量化得出，不要手改。
_pipeline: 立绘 → hero_features.py(量化配色/剪影) → 本文件(语义特征卡) → hero_keyart.py plates(空舞台板：只有画布/地平线/光池/底部留空，不含人物) → hero_keyart.py render(纯文字提示词 → Jenkins TS-Art-Restyle 的 PROMPT_OVERRIDE) → aso_assets.py heroes(压四语文案)。🔴 立绘**只贡献特征**，不当种子：立绘当种子会连姿势/服装/发色一起锁死。

heroes.name: Flade
heroes.hair: short silver-white bob with a heavy side-swept fringe, the tips tinted pale blue, a small gold crown resting in it
outfit: a long white gown with gold filigree trim and a high collar, the skirt falling in layered opaque folds all the way to her ankles
a high-waisted opaque under-skirt so her hips, groin and thighs are fully covered at every angle; thin red rune lines glow only on her forearms and collarbones
red ribbon bindings wound around both wrists
white heeled sandals, toes and heels covered
heroes.weapon: no weapon in her hands — a ring of black spear-pikes stands planted around her, blades turned outward
props: a pair of white bat wings folded behind her shoulders
a long crimson blood-ribbon whipping through the air around her
a single red rose carried on the ribbon
a pool of blood spreading under her feet
heroes.stage: a rain-slicked elevated steel walkway at night, a huge blood-red moon low behind her, city lights blurred into bokeh below
heroes.camera: low three-quarter angle, full body, centred inside the ring of black spears

heroes.name: Danding
heroes.hair: very long straight pale-blonde hair, a black ribbon headband with a dark red rose pinned at the side
outfit: a black gothic-lolita dress: high-neck frilled blouse with red ribbon bows, a black corset with red panel insets, a layered black frilled skirt over a red underskirt, the hem falling to just above the knee
opaque black lace thigh-highs tied with red ribbon, no bare thigh showing above them
black lace-up boots with small heels
heroes.weapon: a giant floating white horned demon-skull grimoire, its pages glowing gold and its bone wings spread wide
props: six white segmented bone arms fanning out behind her, each pierced by a long red nail and tied with red ribbon
blank playing cards drifting in the air around her
a red-orange summoning circle burning on the floor beneath her
heroes.stage: a ruined cathedral nave at night, broken pews and rubble, a burning red summoning circle carved into the floor
heroes.camera: straight-on eye level, full body, the bone arms fanning out to fill the frame behind her

heroes.name: Hailun
heroes.hair: long pale-blonde hair with a soft centre part, ends drifting upward as if weightless
outfit: a white and lilac layered gown with translucent overlapping panels
silver corset lacing at the waist
a short cape attached at the shoulders
bare feet with thin silver anklets
heroes.weapon: a pale lavender paper parasol, held open
heroes.stage: a flooded glass atrium at night, water mirroring the neon above, soft volumetric shafts from the ceiling
heroes.camera: straight-on full body, she floats a metre above the water, parasol arcing over her head

heroes.name: Huamulan
heroes.hair: very long dark teal-black hair, loose and flowing in heavy waves, topped by a pair of black mechanical cat-ear units joined by gold cylinder hinges
outfit: a white cropped jacket worn open with a gold zipper, its whole inner lining a hot orange-to-yellow gradient
a black high-neck crop top underneath, bare midriff
a black pleated mini skirt over black shorts
a white-and-gold armoured gauntlet on her right forearm
one black thigh-high sock on the left leg; the right leg bare with a black knee strap
chunky white-and-black high-top sneakers with gold accents
heroes.weapon: a floating white mechanical orb-mace with a gold cross plate and a glowing orange core, swung on a chain
props: a fan of white segmented mechanical blade-fins spreading out behind her like a single swept wing
a chain whip trailing back from the orb
heroes.vibe: cocky, mid-dash, nothing has managed to catch her yet
heroes.stage: a rain-soaked elevated rail track at night, neon signs streaking past in long exposure
heroes.camera: three-quarter low angle, full body, caught mid-leap with the chain-mace swung out ahead of her

heroes.name: Fububanzang
heroes.hair: purple hair pulled into a high spiky ponytail, one long fringe falling across the left eye
outfit: a white-and-red kitsune mask with fox ears pushed up on the right side of her head
a short indigo-purple kimono jacket with a red gem clasp, worn over a black crop top
black shorts
heavy white-and-black mechanical greaves with glowing cyan seam lines
heroes.weapon: an oversized single-edged katana whose blade is one solid bar of cyan light, slung across her back
props: a thick braided straw rope coiled around her, two large tassels and a brass bell hanging from it
heroes.stage: a scrap yard of dead mechs at night, sparks raining from a severed cable above
heroes.camera: low angle looking up, full body, the cyan blade sweeping a long arc across the upper frame

heroes.name: Fuluoyide
heroes.hair: long golden-blonde hair with a deep side part, one lock curling forward over the shoulder
outfit: a navy-black steampunk top hat with a purple gem and a blue ribbon bow, a long blue bandana ribbon trailing behind it
a black corset leotard with a high collar, a hot-pink bow and magenta glowing seam lines
black shorts with a pink gear emblem on the hip
long mechanical prosthetic legs plated in white crystal with purple-glowing joints and crystal-plated heels
a mechanical claw gauntlet on her left hand
heroes.weapon: a long black mechanical staff, a large glowing purple gear at its head and a magenta spike at its butt
props: purple gear-shaped energy rings spinning around the staff head
a ripple of magenta light running along the floor at her feet
heroes.vibe: smug ringmaster, always one turn of the gear ahead
heroes.stage: a neon theatre backstage, velvet curtains catching magenta light, dust in the spotlight
heroes.camera: straight-on, full body, the staff planted, her weight shifted onto one hip
